xPosts.text: Jensen Huang promotes open-source LLMs for innovation. Great. The next step is democratizing compute. High GPU costs remain one of the biggest barriers to academic research and grassroots innovation. Imagine the impact if NVIDIA also expanded free or heavily subsidized compute

Speaking from my American experience only here. Some people complain about large industry funded research. Don’t forget that almost all of paradigm changing research that led to modern AI came from either large industry labs - Bell Lab, IBM Labs, Xerox Parc, Microsoft, Google,
